name: Vengeance Will Be Yours
summary: Collect thirteen Trophy Hearts in Gulgrethor Fortress and return to Jargo.

sources.title: Vengeance Will Be Yours · Vanguard Archive
Gulgrethor Fortress | Vanguard Saga of Heroes | Fandom

name: Objects of Unknown Power
summary: Collect six Raised Okami Organs and three Torgazu Symbols for Zyrax.

sources.title: Objects of Unknown Power · Vanguard Archive

notes: Embedded Fandom account gives singular item names; main objectives say Okami Organs and Torgazu Symbols. Item spelling requires a tooltip check. Rewards, prerequisite status, exact tracker text and dialogue unknown. Next quest is Got My Eye On Something.

name: Remnants Of The Soulless
summary: Gather six Cursed Soul Shards from souls released by fortress undead, then return to Nuraga.

sources.title: Remnants Of The Soulless · Vanguard Archive
Gulgrethor Fortress | Vanguard Saga of Heroes | Fandom

name: Strong is Weak
summary: Apply counter powders to the four orb altars and return to Nuraga.
notes: Orb names also appear as Contagion's Orb, Miasma's Orb and Vivisector's Orb. DungeonGuru write-up gives 1 silver 60 copper and 6771 XP; archive's separate coin field is 60. Kept explicit denomination value. Use-step interaction details need review; quest must be withheld by converter.
